# durantic_external_bgp_peer (Resource)

Manages a Durantic external BGP peer — a BGP session from a machine to a neighbor outside the mesh, optionally filtered by import and export route policy sets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "durantic_machine" "gateway" {
  hostname = "gateway-01"
}

# Minimal example — only required fields
resource "durantic_external_bgp_peer" "minimal" {
  machine_uuid = data.durantic_machine.gateway.uuid
  name         = "upstream-transit"
  peer_ip      = "192.0.2.1"
  peer_asn     = 64512
}

# Full example with an MD5 password and import/export route policies
resource "durantic_route_policy_set" "upstream_in" {
  name = "upstream-in"
}

resource "durantic_route_policy_set" "upstream_out" {
  name = "upstream-out"
}

resource "durantic_external_bgp_peer" "example" {
  machine_uuid = data.durantic_machine.gateway.uuid
  name         = "upstream-transit"
  peer_ip      = "192.0.2.1"
  peer_asn     = 64512
  local_ip     = "192.0.2.2"
  enabled      = true
  password     = var.bgp_md5_password

  import_policy_uuid = durantic_route_policy_set.upstream_in.uuid
  export_policy_uuid = durantic_route_policy_set.upstream_out.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine_uuid` (String) UUID of the machine that terminates the BGP session. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the external BGP peer.
- `peer_asn` (Number) AS number of the BGP neighbor.
- `peer_ip` (String) IP address of the BGP neighbor.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the BGP session is enabled (default `true`).
- `export_policy_uuid` (String) UUID of the route policy set applied to routes advertised to this peer.
- `import_policy_uuid` (String) UUID of the route policy set applied to routes received from this peer.
- `local_ip` (String) Local IP address to source the BGP session from. When unset, the machine picks one.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) BGP MD5 authentication password. Sensitive — stored in state from your configuration and never read back from the API, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and the value is not populated on import.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the external BGP peer was created.
- `export_policy_name` (String) Name of the export route policy set, if one is attached.
- `import_policy_name` (String) Name of the import route policy set, if one is attached.
- `machine_hostname` (String) Hostname of the machine that terminates the BGP session.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the external BGP peer was last updated.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the external BGP peer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import durantic_external_bgp_peer.example <UUID>
```
